notes: Generator is a static trait (Rust has no zero value to call a method on); built-in impls follow quick.go's sizedValue draw for draw over math/rand (v1), so a seed gives Go's values (checked by tools/testing_check.py). The default count honours -quickchecks; Config.Rand is consumed by a check and restored afterwards.

Check.note: Go builds arguments for any function by reflection. Here the function is a closure with up to eight Generator arguments (Property/Function traits) and a failure reports Debug renderings instead of %#v. Generation, MaxCount handling, the Config.Rand sequence and the verdicts match Go.

CheckEqual.note: Go builds arguments for any function by reflection. Here the function is a closure with up to eight Generator arguments (Property/Function traits) and a failure reports Debug renderings instead of %#v. Generation, MaxCount handling, the Config.Rand sequence and the verdicts match Go.

CheckEqualError.Out1.note: Debug renderings of the results instead of []any.

CheckEqualError.Out2.note: Debug renderings of the results instead of []any.

CheckError.In.note: Debug renderings of the arguments (Vec<String>) instead of []any.

Config.Values.note: Returns the arguments tuple as Box<dyn Any> (downcast to the property's argument type) instead of filling a []reflect.Value.

Value.note: Takes the type as a type parameter (T: Generator) instead of a reflect.Type and cannot fail; the algorithm and size handling are Go's, so a seed yields Go's values for primitives, strings, slices, arrays, maps and options.
